verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents background automation: CI jobs scan automatically on push and pull/merge-request events and send findings to the AppSec Platform. Managed Scans onboard and scan repositories without CI changes, pre-commit hooks run scans on commit, and the platform can send alerts, create tickets and post PR/MR comments without manual intervention. missing for 10: scheduled/cron-style or user-defined general automations, autonomous AI-driven background workflows (e.g. unattended AI triage/remediation runs), independent or hands-on corroboration of these automations.
